sop_modules.name: New Drywall Preparation
sop_modules.description: Prepare new drywall surfaces for primer application. Includes inspection and dust removal. NO spot-priming of fasteners — new drywall fasteners are mudded and rust-resistant (RC-001).

tasks.name: Inspect Drywall Surface
tasks.description: Walk all wall surfaces with work light to identify defects: fastener pops, unfilled joints, damaged paper, ridges, or debris. Mark defects for correction.

quality_notes.QT2: Note only major defects (fastener pops, holes)
quality_notes.QT3: Identify and mark all visible defects including minor ridges
quality_notes.QT4: Comprehensive inspection under bright light, mark all imperfections

tasks.name: Inspect Drywall Surface (Premium)
tasks.description: Detailed inspection of all wall surfaces using work light. Mark all imperfections including minor ridges, scratches, and texture inconsistencies. QT4 requires comprehensive defect identification.

quality_notes.QT4: Comprehensive inspection under bright light, mark all imperfections for correction

tasks.name: Vacuum Drywall Dust
tasks.description: Remove drywall dust from wall surfaces using HEPA vacuum with brush attachment. Dust left on surface will cause adhesion failure.

quality_notes.QT2: Quick pass to remove loose dust
quality_notes.QT4: Complete vacuum with attention to corners and edges

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Inspect → Vacuum. Inspection identifies issues, vacuum removes dust before priming. NO spot-priming of fasteners — new drywall fasteners are mudded and rust-resistant (RC-001).

sop_modules.name: Apply Primer - Roller Method
sop_modules.description: Apply primer coat to walls using roller. Includes cut-in at ceiling edge.

tasks.name: Cut-In Ceiling Edge
tasks.description: Brush-cut primer along wall-to-ceiling boundary. Cut line should be clean and extend 2-3 inches onto wall for roller overlap.

quality_notes.QT4: Crisp edge with minimal brush marks, straight line

tasks.name: Cut-In Ceiling Edge (Premium)
tasks.description: Premium quality brush-cut primer along wall-to-ceiling boundary. Crisp, straight line with no brush marks. QT4 requires meticulous edge work.

quality_notes.QT4: Crisp edge with minimal brush marks, perfectly straight line

tasks.name: Roll Primer on Walls
tasks.description: Apply primer to wall field using 9-inch roller with extension pole. Work in W-pattern, maintain wet edge, avoid lap marks.

quality_notes.all: No application defects — no drips, sags, holidays, or lap marks at any quality tier. Surface must be uniformly sealed. (Surface condition imperfections governed by inspection task tolerance.)

tasks.name: Roll Primer on Walls (Textured Surface)
tasks.description: Apply primer to textured wall surfaces using 3/4-inch nap roller. Heavier nap required to work primer into texture valleys. Maintain wet edge.

quality_notes.all: No application defects — no drips, sags, holidays, or lap marks at any quality tier. All texture valleys must be filled and sealed. (Surface condition imperfections governed by inspection task tolerance.)

tasks.name: Roll Primer on Walls (Premium)
tasks.description: Premium quality primer application for QT4 finish. Uniform mil thickness, no visible lap marks, consistent sheen across all surfaces.

quality_notes.all: No application defects — no drips, sags, holidays, or lap marks at any quality tier.
quality_notes.QT4: Additional: verify uniform mil thickness and consistent sheen

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Cut-in first, then roll. Maintain wet edge between cut-in and roll to avoid lap marks.

sop_modules.name: Apply Primer - Spray + Backroll Method
sop_modules.description: Apply primer via airless spray followed by backroll for consolidation and leveling.

tasks.name: Mask Adjacent Surfaces
tasks.description: Mask ceiling line, door frames, windows, and floor as needed to protect from overspray.

quality_notes.QT2: Basic masking of floors and openings
quality_notes.QT4: Precision masking with clean tape lines

tasks.name: Spray Primer Coat
tasks.description: Apply primer via airless sprayer. Maintain 12-inch distance, 50% overlap, consistent speed. Work top-to-bottom, wet edge.

quality_notes.all: No application defects — no drips, sags, holidays, or lap marks at any quality tier. (Surface condition imperfections governed by inspection task tolerance.)

tasks.name: Spray Primer Coat (Premium)
tasks.description: Premium quality spray primer application. Uniform coverage, consistent mil thickness, no drips or sags. Slower pace with meticulous overlap control.

quality_notes.all: No application defects — no drips, sags, holidays, or lap marks at any quality tier.

tasks.name: Backroll Sprayed Primer
tasks.description: Immediately follow spray with 9-inch roller to consolidate primer into surface, eliminate air pockets, and level finish.

quality_notes.all: No application defects — no drips, sags, holidays, or lap marks at any quality tier. Primer must be fully consolidated into surface. (Surface condition imperfections governed by inspection task tolerance.)

tasks.name: Backroll Sprayed Primer (Premium)
tasks.description: Premium quality backroll for QT4 finish. Thorough consolidation, no stipple, uniform sheen. Multiple passes if needed.

quality_notes.all: No application defects — no drips, sags, holidays, or lap marks at any quality tier. Primer must be fully consolidated into surface.
quality_notes.QT4: Additional: verify uniform sheen, no stipple

tasks.name: Cut-In Ceiling Edge After Spray
tasks.description: Touch up ceiling edge with brush if needed after spray/backroll. Required if masking line is not crisp.

quality_notes.QT3: Clean edge, cover any mask bleed

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Mask → Spray → Backroll (immediately) → Touch-up cut-in. Backroller must follow sprayer closely - spray rate cannot exceed backroll rate.

sop_modules.name: Apply Primer - Spray Only Method
sop_modules.description: Apply primer via airless spray without backroll. Faster but may have more visible texture.

tasks.name: Mask Adjacent Surfaces
tasks.description: Mask ceiling line, door frames, windows, and floor to protect from overspray.

tasks.name: Spray Primer Coat (No Backroll)
tasks.description: Apply primer via airless sprayer. Higher overlap required when not backrolling to ensure even coverage.

quality_notes.all: No application defects — no drips, sags, holidays, or lap marks at any quality tier. (Surface condition imperfections governed by inspection task tolerance.)

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Mask → Spray. No backroll means sprayer must achieve final finish in single pass.

sop_modules.name: Cleanup
sop_modules.description: Clean tools, remove masking, inspect work.

tasks.name: Remove Masking
tasks.description: Remove all masking tape and paper. Pull tape at 45-degree angle to avoid peeling primer. NOTE: In NC production sequence, masking may stay in place for subsequent phases (wall paint, trim) — review whether teardown belongs here or in final cleanup spec.

tasks.name: Clean Tools
tasks.description: Clean brushes, rollers, spray equipment with water. Store or dispose properly.

tasks.name: Light Sand Primer
tasks.description: Light hand sand primed surface with 220 grit to ensure smooth base for finish coats. Required for Level 5 drywall finish at QT4 quality tier. NOTE: This task may belong in the finish spec (SF_DRYWALL_WALL_NC_PAINT) rather than the prime spec — review pending.

quality_notes.QT4: Light sand entire primed surface for Level 5 finish preparation

tasks.name: Final Inspection
tasks.description: Walk all primed surfaces. Check for holidays, missed spots, drips, or edge issues. Touch up as needed.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Remove masking while primer is still slightly tacky for cleanest edge. Clean tools before primer dries.

round_configurations.name: Single Prime Round
round_configurations.description: Standard single coat of primer for new drywall.
round_configurations.notes: Single primer coat is standard for new drywall with topcoat to follow.

round_configurations.name: Prime with Light Sand
round_configurations.description: Primer application with light sand between for premium finish.
round_configurations.notes: Light sand (220 grit) after prime to ensure smooth base for topcoat. Required for Level 5 finish.
